title: Singularity AIDR commercial hard-gate evidence receipt
description: One evidence receipt for one hard gate of docs/production-readiness/commercial-go-evidence-registry.json. The receipts file (docs/production-readiness/commercial-gate-receipts.json) is a JSON array of these records with exactly one record per registry hard gate. A record may say "open" with no evidence at all; it may only say "closed" when it carries a named owner, an effective version and candidate binding, an immutable evidence path with a matching SHA-256, a reviewer whose role differs from the owner's, and a recorded date. The explicit string "REQUIRED" marks a value that a real external counterparty still has to supply; it is never a stand-in for a fact that already exists. Fabricating an owner, approver, signature, date, hash, ticket, pentest, SLA measurement, payment or approval is prohibited by registry.policy.nonWaivableClasses.

gate_id.description: The registry hard gate this receipt answers. This enum mirrors registry.hardGates[].id verbatim and is re-checked against the registry at verification time.

decision.description: Receipt decision for this gate. It must equal registry.hardGates[].status for the same gate; this enum mirrors registry.policy.acceptedStatuses verbatim.

owner_name.description: Named accountable owner. "REQUIRED" until a real person accepts the gate; mirrors policy.closedRequires "named owner".

owner_role.description: Owner role copied verbatim from the registry hardGates[].ownerRole. It is never "REQUIRED" because the registry already fixes the role.

evidence_path.description: Repository-relative path of the immutable evidence artefact. null while the gate is open; mirrors policy.closedRequires "immutable evidence path and SHA-256".

evidence_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact bytes at evidence_path. null while the gate is open; mirrors policy.closedRequires "immutable evidence path and SHA-256".

candidate_digest.description: Release-candidate binding: the SHA-256 of the current release-inventory.json, or null while no candidate is bound, or "unknown" when no release inventory exists on disk. "unknown" can never close a gate.

effective_version.description: Release Candidate commit/version or effective version the evidence is bound to. null while no candidate exists; mirrors policy.closedRequires "Release Candidate or effective version".

recorded_at_utc.description: When the evidence was recorded, RFC3339 UTC with milliseconds. null until a real record exists: a date is never invented; mirrors policy.closedRequires "recorded date".

reviewer_name.description: "REQUIRED" until a reviewer or approver other than the owner accepts the evidence; mirrors policy.closedRequires "reviewer or approver".

reviewer_role.description: "REQUIRED" until a reviewer is assigned. Must differ from owner_role before the gate can close (checked at verification time).

scope.description: What this receipt does and does not cover, including the evidence gap. A real statement, never "REQUIRED".

limitations.description: Known limits of this receipt. Non-empty even when the gate is open: an empty list would hide the gap.

external_inputs.description: The concrete real-world inputs this gate depends on (named people, live systems, signed artefacts). These cannot be produced from this repository and are never fabricated.

then.description: Mirrors registry.policy.closedRequires exactly: named owner; Release Candidate or effective version; immutable evidence path and SHA-256; reviewer or approver; recorded date. A closed receipt can never carry the "REQUIRED" sentinel, a null evidence path, a null/mismatched hash or an unbound candidate digest.
